jds.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Retrieval Platform
jds.text:
Senior Backend Engineer, Retrieval Platform

We are building a retrieval platform. You will own our vector search stack and the embeddings pipeline that feeds it, ship semantic search features, tune Postgres, write Python services, and lead API design for internal consumers.

Must have: vector search, Python, Postgres.
Nice to have: embeddings pipeline, API design.
Seniority: senior.

jds.title: Frontend Engineer, Design Systems
jds.text:
Frontend Engineer, Design Systems

Join the design system team. You will build our React component library in TypeScript, own accessibility standards, and drive web performance across product surfaces.

Must have: React, TypeScript, accessibility.
Nice to have: design system, web performance.
Seniority: mid.

jds.title: ML Platform Engineer
jds.text:
ML Platform Engineer

Our ML platform team needs an engineer for MLOps: model deployment on Kubernetes, a feature store, model monitoring, and PyTorch tooling for research teams.

Must have: model deployment, Kubernetes, PyTorch.
Nice to have: feature store, model monitoring.
Seniority: senior.

jds.title: Data Engineer
jds.text:
Data Engineer

You will build data pipelines in Spark, orchestrate them in Airflow, model our data warehouse in SQL, and add streaming for near-real-time use cases.

Must have: Spark, SQL, data pipelines.
Nice to have: Airflow, streaming.
Seniority: mid.

jds.title: iOS Engineer
jds.text:
iOS Engineer

We need an iOS engineer fluent in Swift to build our mobile app, add offline sync, and own each App Store release.

Must have: Swift, iOS.
Nice to have: offline sync, App Store release.
Seniority: mid.

jds.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jds.text:
Site Reliability Engineer

Site reliability engineer wanted: Terraform, incident response, observability, AWS, and CI/CD ownership.

Must have: AWS, Terraform, incident response.
Nice to have: observability, CI/CD.
Seniority: senior.

jds.title: Application Security Engineer
jds.text:
Application Security Engineer

Application security engineer: penetration testing, threat modelling, OWASP guidance, and secure code review across product teams.

Must have: application security, secure code review.
Nice to have: penetration testing, threat modelling, OWASP.
Seniority: mid.

jds.title: Data Scientist, Experimentation
jds.text:
Data Scientist, Experimentation

Data scientist for our experimentation platform. A/B testing, causal inference, dashboards, statistics, and Python.

Must have: A/B testing, statistics, Python.
Nice to have: causal inference, dashboards.
Seniority: mid.

jds.title: Backend Engineer, Java Platform
jds.text:
Backend Engineer, Java Platform

Backend engineer for our Java platform: microservices, Kafka, distributed systems, Spring Boot.

Must have: Java, microservices.
Nice to have: Kafka, distributed systems, Spring Boot.
Seniority: senior.

jds.title: LLM Application Engineer
jds.text:
LLM Application Engineer

LLM application engineer: prompt engineering, RAG, agents, and evaluation.

Must have: LLM applications, evaluation.
Nice to have: prompt engineering, RAG, agents.
Seniority: mid.

jds.title: Full-stack Engineer, Node
jds.text:
Full-stack Engineer, Node

Full-stack engineer: Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, TypeScript.

Must have: Node.js, TypeScript.
Nice to have: GraphQL, PostgreSQL.
Seniority: junior.

jds.title: Computer Vision Engineer
jds.text:
Computer Vision Engineer

Computer vision engineer: image classification, OpenCV, model optimisation, edge deployment.

Must have: computer vision, model optimisation.
Nice to have: OpenCV, edge deployment, image classification.
Seniority: mid.
